name: HBM Healthcare Investments AG
summary: HBM Healthcare Investments AG specializes in fund of funds and direct investments in middle market and mature companies. The fund prefers to invest in start up, early stage, mid stage, mid venture, late venture, and late stage private companies, unlisted emerging companies, small cap public companies, buyouts, growth capital, and private investment in public equities (PIPES). Within fund of funds, it invests in venture capital funds. It also seeks to finance spin-offs of product lines or departments from larger corporations and the expansion or restructuring of established companies, seed stages, venture capital, expansion capital stages, spin-offs, and buyouts.
